review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Infrastructure)
review_candidates.description: About Nutrient At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical. Your Role at Nutrient... We’re looking for a backend engineer passionate about building robust and scalable systems, excited about working with modern cloud technologies and distributed systems to power our Document Engine and SaaS products. You find satisfaction in architecting high-performance solutions, optimising system reliability, caring for the cloud infrastructure our products run on, and creating efficient backend services that handle complex document processing workflows at scale. You work in an AI-native way: you hand research and implementation work to agents, review their output critically, and build tooling that makes you and the team faster. What You'll Work On... Execute on the design and implementation of high-performance Elixir/Phoenix-based systems such as Nutrient's Document Engine and Web Services API Design and build declarative infrastructure, robust, scalable and easy to observe and maintain (we are currently using Terraform, Terramate and FluxCD on Kubernetes, with Helm charts powering both our managed cloud and customer self-hosted deployments) Operate and evolve our managed cloud platform: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, GitOps workflows, observability, and database operations, keeping it reliable, secure, and costefficient Share ownership for architecture, tools and services, contribute to product development and customer success Collaborate closely with a small, remote-first engineering team to ship features, debug hard problems, and continuously improve reliability Build systems and workflows that use AI to speed up our work, from agent-driven investigation of performance issues to automating repetitive engineering tasks Meet in person with the team periodically to align and reflect What You'll Bring... Experience in backend services and distributed systems A track record running production workloads on Kubernetes and public cloud (we use AWS), ideally with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices Strong coding skills: Elixir experience isn't required, we'll help you learn You work AI-native: agents are part of how you research, investigate and ship code, and you stay fully accountable for what goes out A pragmatic approach to code: you appreciate clean architecture but know when good enough is the right call A culture of direct feedback: you speak up when something isn't right and take feedback just as well Who Thrives Here... At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are: Collaborators: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego. Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth. Curious Thinkers: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right. Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence. Owners: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control. Doers: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges. Why You'll Love Working Here... At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centred on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact. Real platform ownership: You’ll help run and evolve the managed cloud behind Document Engine (cluster lifecycle, GitOps, and observability), not just ship services on top of it. Modern stack end to end: Elixir and Phoenix for the product, Kubernetes with Terraform, Helm, and FluxCD for the infrastructure it runs on. Fully remote and async-first: Minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work. Mission-critical product: Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%+ of the Global 500 across 80+ countries. Strong growth trajectory: ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners, with a $100M+ investment fuelling further growth. Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non-merit factor.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: SII Group – Software Engineer Fondata nel 1979, SII Group è una società di consulenza internazionale con oltre 100 sedi in quattro continenti, specializzata in IT ed Engineering Consulting. Nell'ambito dei nostri progetti nel settore Aerospace & Defence, SII Italia è alla ricerca di un/una Software Engineer. Sede di lavoro: Roma (Ibrido) Settore: Defence Siamo alla ricerca di un Software Engineer con esperienza nello sviluppo di software per sistemi complessi e real-time. Il ruolo sarà coinvolto nelle attività di progettazione, sviluppo, integrazione e verifica del software, contribuendo alla definizione dell’architettura e dei requisiti software. RESPONSABILITÀ PRINCIPALI • Analisi e definizione dei requisiti software. • Progettazione e sviluppo di componenti software per sistemi complessi. • Definizione dell'architettura e delle interfacce software. • Sviluppo e manutenzione di software embedded e real-time. • Supporto alle attività di integrazione, verifica e validazione software. • Esecuzione di test e analisi delle anomalie. • Produzione e gestione della documentazione tecnica di progetto. • Collaborazione con team multidisciplinari Hardware e System Engineering. COMPETENZE TECNICHE • Esperienza nello sviluppo software embedded e/o real-time. • Ottima conoscenza dei linguaggi C e C++ . • Conoscenza dei sistemi operativi Linux e/o Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) . • Esperienza nelle attività di Software Integration, Verification & Validation. • Conoscenza dei principali processi e metodologie di sviluppo software. • Esperienza nell'analisi e gestione dei requisiti software. • Familiarità con strumenti di versioning e configuration management. • Capacità di lavorare all'interno di team multidisciplinari.

review_candidates.title: Physical AI Engineer | Robotics × AI | ¥7M–20M | Full Remote

They are hiring a Physical AI Engineer to combine robotics, simulation, and advanced AI to automate tasks that have traditionally been difficult to handle with conventional systems. ¥7M–20M Full Remote available in Japan Flexible working hours Python / C++ / PyTorch / TensorFlow / ROS 2 Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab / Gazebo / MuJoCo What you’ll work on Reinforcement Learning, Imitation Learning, and Computer Vision Robot simulation using Isaac Sim / Lab, Gazebo, or MuJoCo Designing and leading AI + Robotics PoCs Integrating solutions into ROS 2 environments Deploying and improving systems in real operational environments Applying LLMs / VLMs to next-generation human-robot interaction Translating real business problems into technical requirements and system architecture The company focuses on the AI, control, and digital twin layers , while working with external partners on hardware manufacturing and maintenance. Who they’re looking for Strong Python engineering skills and knowledge of C++ Experience building Deep Learning models with PyTorch or TensorFlow Expertise in at least one of RL, Imitation Learning, or Computer Vision Hands-on experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or MuJoCo Experience technically leading projects or small engineering teams Ability to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders Experience with ROS / ROS 2, Navigation2, MoveIt2, real-world robots, manufacturing, logistics, or LLM/VLM applications is a strong plus. This role could be especially interesting for engineers who want to move beyond simulation or research and build Physical AI systems that are actually deployed into real businesses . If you’re working in Robotics, Embodied AI, Reinforcement Learning, Computer Vision, or Physical AI and are interested in opportunities in Japan, feel free to DM me for the full JD. #PhysicalAI #Robotics #EmbodiedAI #ReinforcementLearning #ComputerVision #ROS2 #MachineLearning #AIEngineer #JapanTechJobs #Hiring

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (Backend)
review_candidates.description: About The Company The Best of Both Worlds At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them. Prefer the flexibility of remote work? You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations. Looking for some social energy? Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia . And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too. We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona , with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve. The Culture is OURS to Create We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting. Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it. Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one. About The Role What you'll do Design, build, and maintain backend services in Go and Python across a microservices architecture deployed on Kubernetes Own features end-to-end — from technical design through deployment and iteration Work closely with clients and client-facing teams to understand requirements and translate them into reliable, scalable solutions Write clean, well-tested, production-ready code and contribute to code reviews Contribute to architectural decisions and help raise the technical bar across the team Help maintain and improve existing client implementations alongside building new capabilities What We're Looking For 3-7+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus Production experience with Go and Python — we primarily use Go, but if your Go experience is limited you can ramp up Strong understanding of microservices and distributed systems Experience with Kafka or similar message queue systems Familiarity with Redis (or equivalent in-memory data stores) and MongoDB Experience working with Kubernetes and containerised services in production Comfortable with AWS and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with high ownership Strong communication skills — you'll be working closely with clients and cross-functional teams Genuine curiosity about AI and how it's reshaping how products are built Nice to have Hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLM integration, or agentic workflows Exposure to vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) Experience in an early-stage or scaling startup Background in security architecture or SRE practices Location Fully remote. We have offices in Madrid, Barcelona, and Valencia - visiting is entirely optional. Why join Maisa! You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges. Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development. Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (AHRS)
review_candidates.description: COME JOIN MID-CONTINENT! “Where your work is valued—above-market pay, real work-life balance, and a team that feels like home.” THE POSITION… As a Software Engineer, you will provide engineering and technical support in the evaluation and testing of existing and emerging technologies, systems, and capabilities. You will design avionics, power electronics, and battery systems with an emphasis on AHRS and INS products using the latest advances in sensor technologies. You’ll create unique intellectual property to address the growing demand for software-defined behavior. You can expect a variety of opportunities ranging from products for cockpit displays, instruments and navigational references based on local and remote sensor inputs. Additional products include data conversion and storage, lithium battery management, AC and DC power conversion, and in-seat power solutions. THIS POSITION MAY BE FOR YOU IF… You have a bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field. You have a minimum of 10 years of experience designing embedded software in the U.S. You have a minimum of 5 years of experience as principal designer for AHRS and INS solutions. You have a minimum of 5 years of experience characterizing and calibrating inertial sensor devices. You have the ability to work directly with target hardware, including lab bench equipment, other tools for debugging and analysis. You have proficiency programming in C. You are proficient with Microsoft Office. You have strong attention to detail. You are organized, focused, and results oriented. You are a problem-solver with critical thinking and prioritizing skills. You have excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills. WE WOULD REALLY LIKE IT IF… (but it’s not a deal breaker) You have experience with C#, C++, or Python languages for PC application software. You have experience with VHDL. You have experience designing safety-critical software, utilizing RTCA DO-178, DO-254 or similar processes. You have experience designing or troubleshooting PCB system hardware. You have experience with Design for Manufacture and Design for Test (DFM & DFT). WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM ONE DAY TO THE NEXT… Design and implement embedded C software for bare-metal microcontroller-based systems with an option for VHDL firmware for FPGA-based systems Architect and implement ARHS and INS products utilizing MEMS, FOG or other commercially available technologies Design tools to support manufacturing, calibration and verification of safety-critical products Build and troubleshoot hardware, including basic soldering, operation of test equipment, and daily work in both office and test lab environments Prototype and execute test programs to verify compliance with applicable performance, regulatory, and quality requirements WE ARE ONE OF THE BEST PLACES TO WORK… We provide above-market pay and a comprehensive benefits package. We promote an environment where you can excel in your career while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Our facility is climate controlled, clean, organized, and safe. We operate in a professional, light manufacturing environment. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right – every time. We have frequent events to keep work interesting. Our food drive is super impressive, we have an annual food truck fest appreciation day, monthly fruit/donut day, employee luncheons throughout the year, wellness challenges with incentives and frequent ticket raffles for local sporting and cultural events. We have a small company feel – even though we’re doing big things! WHO WE ARE… Founded in 1964, Mid-Continent Instruments and Avionics provides superior instruments, avionics and power solutions to the global aerospace community. We operate one of the largest maintenance, overhaul and exchange programs in the world, and deliver safe and certified products, using innovative technologies and sophisticated clean sheet designs. At Mid-Continent Instruments and Avionics, we are committed to quality, service, integrity, and professionalism. Our employees serve the best customers from all over the world in general, business and commercial, advanced air mobility, defense and special missions markets. In this role, you’ll be an important part of the reason our customers consider us a premier instrument, avionics, and aircraft power solutions provider. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. Actual compensation offered within the targeted salary range will be determined by factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Compensation details: 100000-150000 Yearly Salary
